and up to 200 epochs in ARRAU, with early stopping based on the development set. For our model, we pre-train the coreference model for 15 epochs, and the remaining parameters are chosen jointly using grid search to maximize resolution F-score on development data. Specifically, the weights associated with each task and the rule in the loss function (i.e., the $\lambda_{i}$ 's) are searched out of $\{0.1, 0.5, 1, 5, 10, 20, 30\}$ . The weights associated with the mistake-driven cost functions (i.e., the $\Delta_{i}$ 's) are searched out of $\{0.1, 0.5, 1, 5, 10, 15, 20\}$ . The hardness coefficients of the consistency constraints (i.e., the $\gamma_{i}$ 's) are searched out of $\{0.05, 0.1, 0.5, 1, 5, 10, 20, 30\}$ .

We conduct our experiments using a NVIDIA QUADRO RTX 6000. The estimated GPU hour per model in this paper is approximately 6 hours on average. Table 6 shows the final hyperparameters for our full model on the three datasets. Table 6: Final hyperparameters for the full model.
